_meta.purpose: section -> provenance for the published document; site/sources.html renders data/sources.json instead

tape_analysis.note: derived aggregates; every figure is recomputed from data/raw/trades-capture.json, never typed

ranked_events.note: every dollar figure is derived; the formula string is stored per event as dollar_volume_formula

unmapped_trades.note: tape rows whose series is outside the five topics; listed so the exclusion is auditable

portfolio.note: source_mode='paper' means simulated fills; 'demo-live' means read from /portfolio/*

tape_trade_analysis.note: categorisation of OTHER participants' tape fills — market structure, not this account's trades

resolutions.source: result/settlement_ts/settlement_value_dollars are market fields; 'no' means YES holders receive $0 and NO holders $1/contract. https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/market_settlement.md

order_log.note: every create/amend/cancel recorded locally; mode='paper' entries were never sent to Kalshi

scenario.note: which markets could not be priced from the capture is recorded, not dropped

raw_samples.produced_by: verbatim API responses copied into data/snapshot.json during the session
raw_samples.note: kept so a reader can compare the shaped rows the site shows against the raw response

problems.finding: live capture spans 179 ms of tape because sandbox egress to kalshi.co is blocked and each response had to be read through the agent's fetch tool; run scripts/collect.py where network egress is allowed for a true 30-minute window.
